'''August 2001 Levittown tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Tri-County, Levittown, NY on 11 August 2001. [[Matt Ehrhart]] won it. It is known from Matt Ehrhart's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2829">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-12-levittown-ny-8-11-01d2829/ levittown-ny-8-11-01], DeckTech (Matt "TmastamattC" Ehrhart, 12 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-12-levittown-ny-8-11-01d2829/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 11 August 2001
* '''Site:''' Tri-County, Levittown, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Matt Ehrhart]]
